summary: Iteration 67: tested Unlimited Games switch, 100 Free World themes, finish-moment timer, mobile Challenges tab, GC admin Difficulty select, and the level leaderboard 'How to earn tokens' popover. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass against the public URL (/app/tests/test_iter67_theme_unlimited_timer.py). That covers ui-theme and unlimited-games GET/PUT, 401/403 for non-admins, 422 for invalid theme ids ('X!', 'ab', 'UPPER-case', 41 chars), and a unit test of the _finish_moment_ms bounds (543 vs 830 -> 543; window [-3000, +1500]). It also checks live /world/session/submit: a client duration 400ms under server elapsed is kept exactly, +800ms is kept, and a faked 150ms falls back to server elapsed. Frontend: all requested flows pass. Admin switch toggles and persists after reload; /world hides something-special-fab when OFF and shows it when ON. Theme grid has 100 buttons; clicking emerald-classic / ruby-midnight changes the preview gradient instantly; Apply shows a message and the API persists it. On /world the level popup .fwv3-button-primary uses the new accent, and the level leaderboard and result card also follow --fw-accent. Real official Word Unscramble run (player1, L48): request duration_ms 3208, response 3208, server_elapsed 3265 (no network inflation); the stopwatch froze at 00:03.208 and the result showed TIME TAKEN 00:03.208 and CORRECT 6/6, so the iteration_66 counts still work. Mobile 390 /paid-leagues: tabs are Home / Free World / Challenges / Winners; Challenges goes to /login when logged out and /my-account/winnings when logged in. GC admin GC6 (level 1 and champion): memory_match shows Card pairs + Difficulty (10 options), number_sequence shows Numbers to tap + Difficulty, and the select changes. Not saved. Level leaderboard (GC5 L8): lb-level-token-rules-btn opens a popover with 4 rules and the top-5 rewards; Escape closes it. Snow: 72 .pl-snow flakes on the festive map. Settings restored at the end: unlimited ON, theme royal-purple-classic. NOTE: during my run the theme was changed to 'emerald-neon' by another actor (main agent or a concurrent run), not by me.

minor.issue: No allow-list of the 100 theme ids. Any id matching the pattern (e.g. 'not-a-real-theme') is saved with 200. The frontend silently falls back to royal-purple-classic, so the admin sees 'applied' but nothing changes.

design_issues.screen: Free World themes (level popup buttons, leaderboard tabs/level chips)
issues: White text on the --fw-accent background has contrast below 3:1 on 36 of the 100 themes. Examples: Emerald Neon 1.43, Lime Neon 1.35, Teal Neon 1.35, Mint Classic 2.17, Gold Classic 2.51, and most Teal/Mint/Emerald/Forest/Lime/Gold variants plus all those Midnight variants. Seen live with Emerald Neon: the 'Level Leaderboard' tab and the selected L8 chip are white on rgb(6,249,107), which is hard to read. Fix: compute a text colour per theme (dark ink when the accent is light), or darken the accent for Neon/Midnight/Pastel.
Copy still says 'Your official time is measured by the server.' The recorded time is now the client finish moment (server only validates). Consider rewording.
The 'Sound on' pill stays white and is not themed; it stands out on Midnight themes.
Your own row ('Player One') keeps a hard-coded lavender/purple tint that does not follow the theme (seen on Emerald Neon).

action_items: Add per-theme readable text colour (or darken light accents) for the ~36 themes where white-on-accent contrast is below 3:1
Optional: validate theme_id against an allow-list of the 100 ids on the backend (shared JSON or a list mirrored from worldThemes.js)

Optional: PremiumMemory (batch1) calls done() only after the 320ms match animation and its useEffect, so the recorded finish is about 320ms after the final tap. batch1-4 'done' helpers do not pass end/delay_ms the way batch5/6 do. Capture end = Date.now() at the final matching flip and pass delay_ms.
Optional: update 'Your official time is measured by the server' copy
critical_code_review_comments: _finish_moment_ms and its use in session/submit (client games) and champion stopwatch submit look correct. For client games sequence_valid is still duration_ms <= server+1500, and a too-low claim falls back to server elapsed.

applyWorldTheme writes the CSS vars onto document.documentElement, so they persist globally after leaving /world (and on the admin page after Apply). This is fine while only fwv3 / pl-global-lb use --fw-*, but scoping to a world root would be safer.
Memory Match timer: see action item. The finish is recorded after the 320ms animation plus the effect; other batch1-4 games have no delay, so only Memory Match is noticeably affected.

GC admin Difficulty select shows 'Level 3' by default, but when the admin never touches it cfg.difficulty is undefined. FreeWorldNumberSequenceV3 then uses boardLevel=null (no hint, no reshuffle), which behaves the same as level 3, so this is OK but implicit.
FreeWorldNumberSequenceV3.jsx is 2811 lines and should be split (repeat from iteration_66).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend tests with: cd /app/tests && python -m pytest test_iter67_theme_unlimited_timer.py -c /dev/null --rootdir=/app/tests -p no:cacheprovider. The /app/backend/tests conftest skips public-URL tests. Word Unscramble solver: read word-tile-* texts and match sorted letters against the WORDS dict in components/games/premium/batch1.jsx. Click tiles one by one with page.click; one synchronous JS loop fails because of stale React state. 2048 mini can be solved by cycling Left/Down/Right/Down about 400 times. The level leaderboard is reached via plworld-nav-leaderboard -> lb-tab-level. GC admin: gc-select picks the GC, and exact testids gc-game-<n>/gc-game-champion are needed because gc-game-<n>-style/-theme share the prefix. Another actor changed the theme concurrently during this run, so re-check /api/world/public/ui-theme before asserting colours.
